messages:
jess: Quick follow-up from the acct-3787 postmortem. Root cause recap: VPC peering flaps combined with an on-prem stateful firewall rule change dropped our HA health checks which caused isolation of several model runners. Need clear owners/timelines for remediation and recurring-pattern mitigation.

mike: Created a bug ticket for the isolation behavior: `INF-6429`. I'll own the fix (reproducer + unit test + patch). ETA 2w.

anya: I'll coordinate a runbook review with the customer's infra lead and schedule a call. Customer needs a written runbook and verification steps. Aiming for Tues 4/9 for the review.

samir: I'll own the on-prem firewall guidance and produce a hardened ACL template. Will also run an audit of the rules we saw implicated. Draft by EOW (5 business days).

jess: Action items (summarized):
  1) `INF-6429` isolation bug - owner: mike - due: 2026-04-20
  2) VPC peering monitors + BGP reset telemetry - owners: mike/samir - due: 2026-04-13
  3) Customer on-prem runbook + verification steps - owner: anya - due: 2026-04-10
  4) Canary test for prefix/KV cache bypass to detect isolation points - owner: jess - due: 2026-04-08
  5) Fallback policy to hosted variant on repeated peering flaps (`fallback.on_peering_flap=true`) - owner: mike (eng-platform) - target: 2026-05-01

mike: Quick test snippet I'll add to the ticket for peering validation: 
```bash
# verify peering routes and next-hops (example)
ip route show table 100 | grep redwood-vpc || echo "peering-route-missing"
# check BGP neighbor flaps via bgpctl or router API
```

anya: :thumbsup: I'll get customer signoff once the runbook includes the verification commands and escalation path.

incident-bot: Follow-up tickets created: `PM-FW-3787` -> parent, linked to `INF-6429` and `INC-2026-004`. Reminder set for 2026-04-08 to verify AIs.

samir: Observed recurring pattern note: peering flaps correlate with on-prem control-plane bursts (BGP timer resets). Recommend adding a graceful degradation route policy and a circuit-breaker at the routing layer to avoid full isolation.

jess: Agree. Add policy item: automatic fallback to hosted variant when >3 peering flaps in 15m (config flag `fallback.on_peering_flap=true`). Owner: eng-platform (mike). Also add a gate in Dedicated deploys to validate peering stability before large rollouts.

mike: Will add telemetry alert: detect >3 peering resets in 15m -> P1 alert to oncall + paging rule to eng-platform. Adding `ROADMAP-PEER-FALLBACK` ticket.

anya: I'll share the updated timelines with the customer today and confirm they can provide access to their firewall logs.

jess: Thanks all. I'll update the public postmortem doc with these AIs, owners, and dates and will follow up in two weeks to close items. Tags for traceability: `INF-6429`, `PM-FW-3787`, `ROADMAP-PEER-FALLBACK`.

mike: One more note — for private deployments we should ship a small diagnostic agent that runs healthchecks across peered paths and reports back to a customer-only telemetry endpoint. I'll prototype by end of month.

samir: I'll include a security checklist for that agent (least privilege, data minimization) before we consider shipping.

jess: Perfect. Meeting notes and links added to the postmortem doc. If anyone updates due dates, please ping this thread so CS/customer sees changes.
